player_prompt.intro:
Yin e jiɛ̈ɛ̈l {player_id} ({piece}). Jiɛ̈ɛ̈l dɔ̈ɔ̈r e ({opp}). Cɔ̈k yïn ee '[b1 c3]' (kɛɛ̈n → kɛɛ̈n). Jiɛ̈ɛ̈l dɔ̈ɔ̈r kɛɛ̈n ee kɛɛ̈n cɔ̈ɔ̈l chess.
Kɛɛ̈n dhuɔ̈k ee {score_per_capture} pɔ̈ïnth. Tɛ̈ɛ̈m ee kɛɛ̈n {max_moves} kɛɛ̈n, kɛɛ̈n jiɛ̈ɛ̈l dɔ̈ɔ̈r ee kɛɛ̈n bɛ̈ï-bɛ̈ï / jiɛ̈ɛ̈l dɔ̈ɔ̈r ee kɛɛ̈n. Pɔ̈ïnth ba kɔ̈ɔ̈r ee nɔ̈ɔ̈ŋ.
